Message:
libbpf: Struct_ops in SEC("?.struct_ops") / SEC("?.struct_ops.link")

Allow using two new section names for struct_ops maps:
- SEC("?.struct_ops")
- SEC("?.struct_ops.link")

To specify maps that have bpf_map->autocreate == false after open.
